message:
♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V2.1.6 IS LIVE! (PREMIERE PRO)**

Version 2.1.6 brings complete stopwatch keyframing to the Transform Card, eliminates panel startup and Auto Caption freezes, and introduces major performance optimizations.

*(Install over your current version with your ZXP installer and restart Premiere Pro once to apply the update.)*

♦️ **New Transform Card Keyframing (General ▸ Transform)**
* **Full Stopwatch & Navigation:** Anchor Point, Position, Scale, Rotation, and Opacity now feature functional stopwatches with previous/next keyframe jump arrows.
* **Visual State & Auto-Keying:** Stopwatches illuminate when properties are animated, clicking toggles keyframes at the playhead, and editing values between keyframes automatically creates a keyframe.

♦️ **Fixes for Startup & Tab Freezes**
* **Instant Start-up:** Removed upfront Python and Whisper checks on launch, completely resolving blank panel startup delays.
* **Zero-Freeze Auto Captions:** Dependency verification results are now cached so opening the Auto Captions tab no longer locks the UI for 20 seconds.
* **Reliable Transform Values:** Numeric fields no longer fail on non-English Premiere installs or clips with linked audio; dragging inputs registers as a single undo step, and Non-Uniform Scale handles discrete X/Y dimensions.

♦️ **Performance Overhaul & Lightweight Themes**
* **Optimized Polling & Background Pausing:** Throttled heavy state checks to a few times per second, rendering tabs instantly while suspending animations when the mouse leaves the panel.
* **Smoother Themes:** Reduced theme particles by 50%, softened heavy glows, and added an upfront performance notice when switching away from the default Accent Color theme.
* **Mouse Wheel Tab Navigation:** Hover and scroll your mouse wheel directly over the top tab bar to cycle through views.
